name: @kriya-ui/standalone
description: Electron standalone shell (gate A-1 hardening). Only the main process spawns processes, and only the allowlisted kriya command grammar.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.build:inspector-legacy: npm run build:main && VITE_KRIYA_UI=inspector vite build
scripts.build:cockpit-fixture: npm run build:main && VITE_KRIYA_UI=cockpit VITE_KRIYA_PROVIDER=fixture vite build
scripts.build:cockpit: npm run build:main && VITE_KRIYA_UI=cockpit vite build && node scripts-check-bundle.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:cockpit && node mac-app.mjs package
